walkthroughs.body_html:
Tawhid is the absolute oneness of Allah.

Allah has no partners, no equals, and no images. Surah 112 (Al-Ikhlas) says: 'Say, He is Allah, the One.'

Shirk (associating partners with Allah) is the gravest sin in Islam.

Sunni Muslims hold six core beliefs:

1. Tawhid (one God)
2. Malaikah (angels)
3. Holy books (Qur'an, Torah, Injil, Psalms, Scrolls of Abraham)
4. Risalah (prophets)
5. Akhirah (Day of Judgement)
6. Qadr (predestination — Allah knows all)

Shi'a Muslims hold the Five Roots of Religion (Usul al-Din):

1. Tawhid (oneness)
2. Adl (divine justice)
3. Nubuwwah (prophethood)
4. Imamah (leadership of the Imams)
5. Mi'ad (Day of Judgement)

Adl — God's justice — is especially distinctive in Shi'a thought.
